conflicts.fact: Which experiment Lesson 4 contained and what dataset Lessons 5 and 7 build on from it
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 is a starch test practical on a variegated or partially covered leaf, with no Elodea bubble counts. Lesson 5 says it anchors on Lesson 4 Elodea oxygen-bubble data at different light intensities. Lesson 7 has learners collect the Elodea bubble data at different lamp distances for the first time.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson began the cumulative photosynthesis model and what it depicts
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 starts 'Version 1' of the model, a whole-plant diagram. Lesson 5 says the model was begun in Lesson 1 as a chloroplast diagram, and that the Lesson 4 version was a chloroplast black box. Lesson 6 says it was started in Lesson 3 and revised in Lessons 4-5. Lesson 8 says it was built across Lessons 4-7. Lesson 9 says it began in Lesson 1.

conflicts.fact: Which lessons covered the light-dependent reactions
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 says the light-dependent reactions were covered in Lessons 4-5. Lesson 4 is the starch test and covers no light-dependent reactions.

conflicts.fact: Number of lessons/ending point and model references
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says 'ten lessons' and that the final model is in Lesson 10. Lesson 7 says wilting will be addressed 'in the next lesson', but Lesson 8 does not address it. Lesson 6 DQB says wilting questions are 'coming', yet no lesson explains transpiration, and Lesson 10 treats wilting as resolved.

conflicts.fact: Cause of wilting: why stomata open and time frame
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says strong light triggers stomata to open wide and that stomata close at night. Lesson 10 says high light and temperature accelerate transpiration. Lesson 3 says wilting is due to peak irradiance opening stomata for CO2. Lesson 7 says the wilting puzzle is unexplained and will be addressed next lesson, yet Lesson 8 doesn't cover it.

conflicts.fact: Temperature at which rate peaks or enzymes denature
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8 Observe dataset peaks at ~35 °C and Learned says enzymes denature above ~40 °C. Lesson 8 data runs to 45 °C with sharp decline after 35 °C, a mild inconsistency with 40 °C.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 7 photo description of the plants
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 shows the plant wilting at midday and healthy in the morning in full sun. Lesson 7 describes the full-sun plot as 'bright green and upright in the morning' under midday sun photograph (A), mixing times, and says 'the same plot after two weeks under a mango tree' while the phenomenon says several weeks.
The phenomenon says a form 4 student in Nairobi (Lesson 1 gives Amina, from Kasarani), while Lesson 9 places the healthy comparison garden in Kiambu.
